desc:
Welcome to Operator's Life, Bergen Av line. A place to drive trains or railfan based on the New York City Transit system. 
Super-Express direction: To 96 St on even number days, To 179 St on odd number days. Based on Eastern Time.

To know if you own gamepasses, check the store in-game.

Play this game on a good device with decent RAM for best performance, especially when driving full length trains.

For the latest development updates, consider joining us. 
Our communications server: In game page (social links for 13+ only)
Our group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/5337366/Operators-Life
